plan.field_definition: Cell E is arithmetic mean of signed conservative opposite-face fields; independent of reference; contactq=I/actualcontactlength
plan.reference: Published P128-H2048 finite Galerkin solution; conditional comparator, NOT continuum truth

spec.coordinate_system: Periodic x over2mm; depthz0top to0.1mmbottom; unit out-of-plane length. I:A/m,complexpower:W/m.
spec.excitation: One synthetic equipotentialpatch1Vpeak=2Vpp, entirebottom0V. No50ohm/fourpad/material/hardware model.

operators.boundary_fitted: Insert exactcontact endpoints into xedges; fullcontactfaces use physicalareaRobin

spec.reference_projection: Exact analytic Fourier rectangle-average Ex/Ez; primary full physical L2 includes finite-reference Parsevalenergy. Secondary cell-average projection is separately labelled smoothing.
spec.contact_comparison: Primary pairwise physical interval intersections versus native BEMpanels; secondary conservative length-averageprojection separate.
spec.reference_validity: Finite panel/harmonic diagnostics passed; edgeJmax not continuum-converged. This stage establishes no actualphantom/contact model correction.

cases.contact_maximum_scope: Mesh-dependent piecewise constant patch density, not continuum maximum

physical_E_comparison.reference_integral: Exact finite Fourier Parseval energy and analytic rectangle averages, no pointwise or indexwise subtraction
physical_E_comparison.secondary_scope: Averaged projection can conceal unresolved reference-field variation

contact_comparison.interpretation: Primary retains panel/subcell variation; secondary averaging can hide error. No indexwise difference or continuum-edge-maximum claim.
